lt.reason: Complaint A. L182 prints only the count (≥ when PARTIAL), the period and STALE. It never says how many days were searched, so every window of 30 days or more shows the same label: [≥1,480 | 30d/3m/6m/12m STALE] reproduced at lightning 2a49652, 13:45Z (periods-2a49652-1345.json).

cv.reason: Complaint A. L52-53 already computes d (window dates), u (unscanned) and l (lost). That is the searched-days count the label lacks: 29/31, 29/93, 29/184, 29/366.

cf.reason: Complaint A. L94 sets PARTIAL whenever less than 100% of the window was searched, which becomes the ≥ prefix in lt. The state is right; the symbol is ambiguous.

sl.reason: Complaint A. The status line (L184) already tells the windows apart (SEARCHED 88% / 28% / 14% / 7%), but the label above it does not.

lw.reason: Complaint A. L80-87 sums whole overlapping days and auto-loads within the cap, so every window of 30 days or more fetches the same 29 day files and draws the same 1,480 points. This is correct, but nothing on screen tells the windows apart.

stale.reason: Complaint A. STALE is true (index next_update_due_utc 13:43:35Z at 2a49652, now 13:45Z). The cause is the collector schedule outside this module, not L47.

nr.reason: Complaint B. L156 keeps kv[0]>=132 and the nearest 3. The owner expects 33 kV and about 5 links, which is the public link.measure.nearestSubstations (cartridge L3513/L3584: MIN_KV 33, LINK_COUNT 5, MAX_LINK_KM 40). There is no 40 km radius. addSource/addLayer at L159-162 are unguarded, so a throw after the text list (L157) leaves text and no lines, and nothing is recorded in S.errors.

near.reason: Complaint B. L163 calls nr and then only cpos(): no camera move. At zoom 6 a 5.42 km line is 7.2 px long, inside the 8.2 px flash dot (line-width 0.9 px), so drawn lines are invisible unless the map is framed. The deep link frames at zoom about 12 (460 px).

tap.reason: Complaint B. The card (L145) is up to 280 px wide and as tall as the map, placed with its bottom edge 14 px above the flash (L132). On a 393 px phone it covers the lines' northern half. The full flash ID is printed (L147).

cpos.reason: Complaint B. Re-placement after NEAREST is node-tested only and not browser-proven (I-progress.md).

pc.reason: Complaint B. Every map tap closes the card and removes the lines before any hit test (L143). This is by design, but a stray tap erases the answer.

cartridge:nearestSubstations.reason: Public (link.measure.nearestSubstations, L3584): 33 kV and above, 5 links, 40 km radius. This is what the module should call; nr duplicates it with other constants.

cartridge:drawLinks.reason: Expected path. Draws the neon lines, nodes and km · kV labels, and frames a declared link with fitBounds (L4594). The module copies its paint (L158 vs L4535).

cartridge:nearestTransmission#2.reason: Second declaration named nearestTransmission (L1975) that only delegates to L623. Its ≥400 kV is a third transmission threshold next to the module's 132 and MIN_KV 33.

cartridge:engine map.on('click').reason: Fires on the same map click as Lightning's tap (L6191). A flash tap that also hits a project or substation opens the engine popup and neon links too; a tap on empty basemap runs clearLinks (L6212).

cartridge:popupWatcher.reason: Clears the neon links whenever no .maplibregl-popup is open (L6060). This is why link.selectAt cannot be reused for a flash card without the engine popup.

cartridge:addCardBar.reason: The original card bar (L3950) the owner expects. Lightning replaced it with its own card (I1), because the bar's minimised state hid the popup content.

global:__GRIDATLAS_SUBSTATIONS__.reason: Fallback read by nr (L154) and by the cartridge (L8372, L8410, L8535). Nothing in hardening/wt/atlas writes it: a dead fallback.

layer:gridatlas-lightning-nearest-label.reason: The km · kV label layer was never rendered in the browser run (shim style has no glyphs: BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY, I-progress.md). text-allow-overlap is off, so labels of nodes a few px apart collide.
